selection: PRIMARY: July 2006 large flood brackets 2014 upstream discharge scale. Chosen before scoring 2014; retain estimated-value caveats and channel changes.
objective: Minimum RMSE on approved unqualified exact UTC pairs after 24h warm-up

score.warning: Metrics on exact matched samples only; sparse coverage can miss the event peak. A fitted event is not independent validation.

warning: Retrospective held-out event, not blinded: 2014 target peak/time were already known in research. Parameters fitted only to separate pre-2014 observations. Small-storm extrapolation / channel changes are limitations.
